rawText: Thank you for interviewing with us on Tuesday. John Doe (john.doe@fintechcorp.io, +1-415-555-0199) and the interviewing panel reviewed your performance for the Senior Backend Engineer loop. Overall, the team was impressed by your strong concurrent programming knowledge in Go and how you handled database index optimization with great clarity. However, the committee noted that your answer regarding distributed cache failure was unstructured and hard to follow. In particular, you missed concrete examples when discussing cache eviction policies and jumped around without signposting your approach. We would like to see a clear headline followed by a step-by-step failure recovery mechanism. You can check our engineering blog at https://fintechcorp.io/eng for reference.
